answer: Agents photograph lotus ponds below a ledge and yarrow above it for a field survey. Every approved camera has a certified, nonexportable key. To earn one payment per round it signs the round's fresh nonce and photo hash. A shared ledger marks its factory serial paid across all agent accounts. One camera cannot collect n payouts through n aliases; more slots require buying or renting additional certified cameras. This assumes honest certification and unclonable keys, and limits identity inflation, not false observations.
